steps.name: environment
steps.description: Persist NODE_ENV and PORT into /etc/profile.d/webfrontend_env.sh idempotently. Ensure npm global bin is computed at profile-source time, validate node (>=18) and npm present, create workspace directory, and source the profile into current session (non-fatal) so subsequent steps inherit settings.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98491/WebFrontend"
PROFILE=/etc/profile.d/webfrontend_env.sh
TMP=$(mktemp)
cat >"$TMP" <<'SH'
# WebFrontend env defaults (only set if not already set)
export NODE_ENV="${NODE_ENV:-development}"
export PORT="${PORT:-3000}"
# Compute npm global bin at source time and prepend to PATH if not present
if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  NPM_GBIN="$(npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || echo /usr/local/bin)"
  case ":$PATH:" in
    *:"$NPM_GBIN":*) ;;
    *) export PATH="$NPM_GBIN:$PATH";;
  esac
fi
SH
if sudo cmp -s "$TMP" "$PROFILE" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo rm -f "$TMP"
else
  sudo mv "$TMP" "$PROFILE" && sudo chmod 0644 "$PROFILE" && sudo chown root:root "$PROFILE"
fi
# Validate node and npm
if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: node not found on PATH" >&2 && exit 3; fi
if ! command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: npm not found on PATH" >&2 && exit 4; fi
NODE_V=$(node -v | sed 's/^v//')
NODE_MAJOR=$(printf "%s" "$NODE_V" | cut -d. -f1 || echo 0)
if [ "${NODE_MAJOR:-0}" -lt 18 ]; then echo "ERROR: Node >=18 required, found $NODE_V" >&2 && exit 5; fi
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE"
# Source profile for current session, non-fatal
[ -f "$PROFILE" ] && . "$PROFILE" || true

steps.name: scaffolding
steps.description: Create a minimal React app in the workspace non-interactively. Idempotent: refuse to scaffold into a non-empty project if common app files/directories exist (src/, public/, index.html, or package.json with scripts). Prefer local create-react-app, fallback to npx create-react-app, then npm create/init vite@latest with react template. Stash partial output to .scaffold_backup on failure. Add a minimal client-side Upload component and README.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98491/WebFrontend"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
if [ -d src ] || [ -d public ] || [ -f index.html ] || ( [ -f package.json ] && node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); process.exit(p.scripts&&Object.keys(p.scripts).length?0:1)" >/dev/null 2>&1 ); then
  exit 0
fi
mkdir -p .scaffold_backup || true
TIMESTAMP=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
stash_fail(){ tar -czf ".scaffold_backup/partial_$TIMESTAMP.tar.gz" . --exclude .scaffold_backup || true; }
SCAFFOLD_TYPE=""
LOG=/tmp/webfrontend_scaffold.log
if command -v create-react-app >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if create-react-app . --use-npm --no-analytics --silent >"$LOG" 2>&1; then SCAFFOLD_TYPE="cra"; fi
fi
if [ -z "$SCAFFOLD_TYPE" ] && command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if npx --yes create-react-app . --use-npm --no-analytics --silent >"$LOG" 2>&1; then SCAFFOLD_TYPE="cra"; fi
fi
if [ -z "$SCAFFOLD_TYPE" ]; then
  if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm create vite@latest . -- --template react --yes >"$LOG" 2>&1; then SCAFFOLD_TYPE="vite"; fi
  if [ -z "$SCAFFOLD_TYPE" ] && command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if npm init vite@latest . -- --template react --yes >"$LOG" 2>&1; then SCAFFOLD_TYPE="vite"; fi
  fi
fi
if [ -z "$SCAFFOLD_TYPE" ]; then
  stash_fail || true
  echo "ERROR: scaffolding failed; see $LOG" >&2
  exit 6
fi
mkdir -p src/components || true
cat > src/components/Upload.jsx <<'COMP'
import React from 'react';
export default function Upload(){
  return (<input type="file" accept="image/*" data-testid="file-input"/>);
}
COMP
cat > README.md <<MD
# WebFrontend
Scaffold: ${SCAFFOLD_TYPE}
Headless: use HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT and NODE_ENV environment variables. Start with: npm start (CRA) or npm run dev (Vite).
MD

steps.name: dependencies and scripts
steps.description: Install minimal runtime deps (react, react-dom) if missing, ensure project-local jest devDependency and minimal eslint config, and merge minimal scripts into package.json atomically while preserving existing scripts. Fix previous inline node quoting errors by writing a temporary JS merger via here-doc and invoking node with that file. Do not default scaffold type if inconclusive; surface an error. Backup package.json before editing and validate package.json after edits.

output_scripts.name: deps_and_scripts
output_scripts.code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Step: dependencies and scripts
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98491/WebFrontend"
cd "$WORKSPACE"

# Ensure npm present
command -v npm >/dev/null || (echo "ERROR: npm missing" >&2 && exit 3)
command -v node >/dev/null || (echo "ERROR: node missing" >&2 && exit 4)

# Detect scaffold type conservatively
SCAFFOLD_TYPE="unknown"
if [ -f package.json ]; then
  # detect CRA by presence of react-scripts in deps
  node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); const deps=Object.assign({},p.dependencies||{},p.devDependencies||{}); process.exit(deps['react-scripts']?0:1)" >/dev/null 2>&1 && SCAFFOLD_TYPE="cra" || true
  if [ "$SCAFFOLD_TYPE" = "unknown" ]; then
    # detect Vite by vite in deps or scripts referencing vite
    node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); const deps=Object.assign({},p.dependencies||{},p.devDependencies||{}); if(deps['vite']||Object.keys(p.scripts||{}).some(s=>p.scripts[s].includes('vite'))) process.exit(0); else process.exit(1)" >/dev/null 2>&1 && SCAFFOLD_TYPE="vite" || true
  fi
fi

# Backup package.json if present
[ -f package.json ] && cp package.json package.json.bak || true

# Install react/react-dom only if missing
if node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p=fs.existsSync('package.json')?JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json')):{}; if(!(p.dependencies&&p.dependencies.react)) {process.exit(0);} process.exit(1)" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  # react missing -> install runtime deps
  npm i --no-audit --no-fund react react-dom --silent || (echo "ERROR: failed to install react/react-dom" >&2 && exit 5)
fi

# Write minimal eslint config (idempotent overwrite)
cat > .eslintrc.json <<'JSON'
{ "env": {"browser": true, "es2021": true}, "extends": ["eslint:recommended"], "parserOptions": {"ecmaVersion": 12, "sourceType": "module"}, "rules": {} }
JSON

# Ensure project-local jest devDependency
HAS_JEST=1
if [ -f package.json ]; then
  node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); process.exit(p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies.jest?0:1)" >/dev/null 2>&1 || HAS_JEST=0
else
  HAS_JEST=0
fi
if [ "$HAS_JEST" -eq 0 ]; then
  npm i --no-audit --no-fund -D jest@^29 --silent || (echo "ERROR: failed to install jest" >&2 && exit 6)
fi

# Minimal jest config
cat > jest.config.js <<'JS'
module.exports = { testEnvironment: 'jsdom', testMatch: ['**/src/**/?(*.)+(spec|test).js?(x)','**/__tests__/**/*.js?(x)'] }
JS

# Merge minimal scripts via temporary JS merger to avoid quoting issues
if [ -f package.json ]; then
  MERGER_JS=$(mktemp)
  cat > "$MERGER_JS" <<'NODE'
const fs=require('fs');
const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json'));
p.scripts=p.scripts||{};
const s=p.scripts;
const t=process.argv[2];
if(t===undefined){ console.error('ERROR: scaffold type undefined'); process.exit(2); }
if(t==='cra'){
  s.start = s.start || 'react-scripts start';
  s.build = s.build || 'react-scripts build';
  s.test  = s.test  || 'jest --runInBand';
} else if(t==='vite'){
  s.dev   = s.dev   || 'vite';
  s.start = s.start || 'npm run dev';
  s.build = s.build || 'vite build';
  s.test  = s.test  || 'jest --runInBand';
} else {
  console.error('ERROR: scaffold type inconclusive; please inspect package.json');
  process.exit(2);
}
fs.writeFileSync('package.json', JSON.stringify(p,null,2));
NODE

  if [ "$SCAFFOLD_TYPE" = "unknown" ]; then
    rm -f "$MERGER_JS"
    echo "ERROR: scaffold type inconclusive; cannot merge scripts automatically" >&2
    exit 6
  fi

  node "$MERGER_JS" "$SCAFFOLD_TYPE" || (echo "ERROR: unable to merge scripts; scaffold type: $SCAFFOLD_TYPE" >&2 && rm -f "$MERGER_JS" && exit 7)
  rm -f "$MERGER_JS"
else
  # No package.json: create minimal scripts (Vite-style defaults) and minimal package skeleton
  echo '{}' > package.json
  node -e 'const fs=require("fs"), p={name:"webfrontend",version:"0.0.0",scripts:{start:"npm run dev",dev:"vite",build:"vite build",test:"jest --runInBand"}}; fs.writeFileSync("package.json", JSON.stringify(p,null,2));'
fi

# Validate package.json
node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('package.json'))" >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo 'ERROR: package.json invalid after modifications' >&2 && exit 8)

# Success
exit 0

steps.summary:
Added a minimal transform-free Jest smoke test at src/__tests__/smoke.test.js and attempted to run tests non-interactively with CI=1. The test file was created successfully. Running the project-local test runner failed because Jest reported missing test environment module: "jest-environment-jsdom". This occurs with Jest >=28 where jest-environment-jsdom is no longer bundled automatically. The script attempted to run npm test and fell back to npx jest; both paths failed with the same error from Jest.

Actions performed:

  - Creates src/__tests__/ and writes a simple smoke test (2+2===4)
  - Exports CI=1
  - Attempts to run npm test (silently) and falls back to npx --yes jest
- Captured the failing Jest output: "Test environment jest-environment-jsdom cannot be found... As of Jest 28 'jest-environment-jsdom' is no longer shipped by default, make sure to install it separately." This caused the runner to exit with code 3.

What remains to make tests pass:
- Install the missing test environment package as a dev dependency in the project: jest-environment-jsdom. Example: npm i -D jest-environment-jsdom
- Alternatively, adjust Jest config to use the node testEnvironment (if DOM not required) by adding to package.json: "jest": { "testEnvironment": "node" }
- Ensure jest is present as a project devDependency or that npx can use a global/local jest that matches the project. The container image includes jest preinstalled, but project-local configuration commonly expects project-local jest. Installing jest as a devDependency (npm i -D jest) and jest-environment-jsdom is recommended.

I did not modify package.json or install dependencies automatically because this testing step depends on the earlier dependency setup step (deps-003). Per the provided plan, installing/merging devDependencies belongs to that step. The failure is precisely the missing package dependency that deps-003 must add.

steps.name: validation
steps.description: Build (if applicable), start the dev server bound to 0.0.0.0, wait for HTTP 2xx/3xx or an open TCP port, then stop the server cleanly by killing the server process group. Capture logs to /tmp/webfrontend_dev.log and provide diagnostics on failure. Depends on prior steps.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98491/WebFrontend"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
LOG=/tmp/webfrontend_dev.log
: >"$LOG"
[ -f /etc/profile.d/webfrontend_env.sh ] && . /etc/profile.d/webfrontend_env.sh || true
PORT=${PORT:-3000}
HOST=${HOST:-0.0.0.0}
SCRIPTS_JSON=$(node -e "try{const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.scripts||{}));}catch(e){console.log('{}')}" 2>/dev/null)
START_CMD=()
if node -e "try{const p=require('./package.json'); const deps=Object.assign({},p.dependencies||{},p.devDependencies||{}); process.exit(deps['react-scripts']?0:1)}catch(e){process.exit(1)}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  START_CMD=("npx" "--no-install" "react-scripts" "start")
elif node -e "try{const p=require('./package.json'); const deps=Object.assign({},p.dependencies||{},p.devDependencies||{}); process.exit(deps['vite']?0:1)}catch(e){process.exit(1)}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if echo "$SCRIPTS_JSON" | grep -q 'dev'; then
    START_CMD=("npm" "run" "dev" "--")
  else
    START_CMD=("npx" "--yes" "vite" "--host" "0.0.0.0")
  fi
else
  START_CMD=("npm" "start" "--")
fi
export HOST PORT CI=1
if npm run | grep -q "build"; then npm run build >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || echo "build failed (non-fatal)" >>"$LOG"; fi
# Start server in background and capture PID
"${START_CMD[@]}" >>"$LOG" 2>&1 &
SERVER_PID=$!
sleep 0.5
PGID=$(ps -o pgid= -p "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ' || echo "")
[ -z "$PGID" ] && PGID="$SERVER_PID"
cleanup(){
  kill -TERM -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  sleep 1
  kill -KILL -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
SECS=0
OK=0
while [ $SECS -lt 60 ]; do
  HTTP_CODE=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/" 2>/dev/null || echo 000)
  case "$HTTP_CODE" in
    2*|3*) OK=1; break;;
  esac
  if command -v nc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    nc -z 127.0.0.1 "$PORT" >/dev/null 2>&1 && { OK=1; break; }
  else
    (echo > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$PORT) >/dev/null 2>&1 && { OK=1; break; } || true
  fi
  sleep 1; SECS=$((SECS+1))
done
if [ "$OK" -eq 1 ]; then
  echo "SERVER_OK"
  cleanup
  trap - EXIT
  exit 0
else
  echo "SERVER_FAILED" >&2
  echo "--- last lines of $LOG ---" >&2
  tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2 || true
  cleanup
  trap - EXIT
  exit 2
fi
